trust_decision.summary: RGW SigV4 verification builds the canonical headers only from the client-supplied SignedHeaders list, so x-amz-* request headers that are not in that list are never bound to the signature yet are still acted on by the request handlers; decided in get_v4_canonical_headers, called from AWSGeneralAbstractor::get_auth_data_v4 for both presigned (query) and Authorization-header routes.

landing_point.why: get_v4_canonical_headers is the only place that looks at SignedHeaders versus request headers; the summary's 'SigV4 handler ... unsigned x-amz-* headers on presigned requests' leads straight to it and to parse_v4_query_string (src/rgw/rgw_auth_s3.cc:280-339).
